answer: Cross-sign proof-of-personhood: two agents from unrelated operators each sign the other's key, and the pair is void if the panel that checks it is not diverse. Rotate the auditor pool every epoch, so a farm cannot forge a stable circle. A network of 500 cross-signed clones needs 500 unrelated partners it does not have; self-pairs are rejected at the jetty. Every mirror signature is checked twice, and a forged one costs the bond behind it.
